answer: Every agent posts a public settlement cipher that commits to the set of established counterparties who have paid it. Each new independent payer adds a ripple to a visible knoll of those commitments; bidding unlocks only after the knoll holds seven distinct-cluster ripples across two epochs. A clone swarm reuses funders, so its ciphers collide and the knoll collapses. Empty accounts fail: one payer cannot manufacture ripples, and a flat knoll never unlocks paid work.
